name: Yr Wyddor Gymraeg
notes: Welsh treats digraphs as single letters for dictionary order. There is no k, q, v, or z in native words. j appears mainly in loanwords.

letters.name: ec
letters.approx_en: always k as in cat, never s

letters.name: eg
letters.approx_en: g as in go, never j

letters.name: i
letters.approx_en: ee as in see (also y-glide before a vowel)

letters.name: ell
letters.approx_en: voiceless lateral fricative; blow air past the sides of the tongue

letters.name: ffi
letters.approx_en: f as in phone (aspirate mutation of p)

letters.name: es
letters.approx_en: s as in sun, never z

letters.name: u
letters.approx_en: South: like i (ee). North: high central vowel

letters.name: w
letters.approx_en: oo as in food, or w-glide

letters.name: y
letters.approx_en: clear: ee/i; obscure (unstressed): uh as in the
